# Custom QR code generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/qr-code/

Create a static QR code from text or a URL and export a scalable SVG or high-resolution PNG. No tracking or link-shortening service is used.

## How to use it

1. Enter the text or URL to encode.
2. Choose a style, dark code color and light background.
3. Download PNG or SVG, then verify the code with a scanner.

## Example

Make a QR code for a website address and download an SVG for a printed card.

## Limits and checks

Scan the exported code before printing. Leave its quiet-zone border visible and avoid stretching the code into a non-square shape.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
